cases.long_description: My family and I observed these large, glowing, reddish orange objects moving across the sky in intervals, all headed in the same direction and not making any sounds. No blinking lights, so couldn't be airplanes. Objects were above the tall trees here, but not too high in the sky and were rather large, (appeared slightly larger than a basketball, while up in the sky). We observed the glowing objects steadily moving across the area for at least 15 minutes. Earlier, before the red/orange objects, several very bright while lights/objects were also observed moving across the sky in the same area and borealis like light patterns were also seen in the sky, which is odd for Oklahoma.
cases.location: Series of at least 8-9 large glowing reddish orange objects moving across the sky at intervals, all heading in the same direction, without sound

At first, I saw 1 light high in the sky off to what I believe was southeast (I will verify directions today). It seemed to pulsate white light and had no other lights visible. I see planes in the sky here all the time, so at first thought it might be something like a star or planet, but it was kind of early for it. I pointed it out to some others who were out. One person said it was an airplane, but we typically could see the bodies of the airplanes, and it did not have navigation lights. Just then, a 2nd smaller (very tiny and barely visible) white dot appeared close to the first object. I realized if they were planes, they were dangerously close. That's when I started recording it on my phone.

cases.long_description: While traveling out of state on I-44E (NE actually) just outside of Springfield, Missouri at 11:44am, I observed ahead of me a strange cloud in the shape of a perfect ball. I then noticed long clouds that are long and skinny and had a dark shelf underneath them. I panned to my left and took pics of the clouds out my driverside window.
